---
title: Some random stuff about me...
---

Hi! I'm Palmer Maurer, a recent graduate of Georgetown University with a Bachelor of Science in Mathematics. I began my academic journey as a chemistry major on the pre-med track, but over time I developed a stronger passion for mathematics, data science, and machine learning. That shift ultimately shaped both my academic interests and my professional goals.

I'm from Princeton, NJ, and I'm a dedicated New York Yankees fan, hence the theme of this project. I enjoy spending time with family and friends and especially adored my family dog, Twix (pictured below), who passed recently. I also love golfing, listening to rock music (e.g., *The Eagles* and Bruce Springsteen), and playing the cello, which I've played for many years, most recently as a member of the Georgetown University Orchestra.

Travel is another passion of mine, and Italy holds a special place in my heart. I've been very fortunate to visit several times with my family, and exploring every region remains a bucket list item of mine.
